CustomField.description: Original Lawyer Grouping for Board Reports (1, 2-5, 6-10, 11-25, 26+
CustomField.formula: IF ((Bound_Lawyer_Count__c == 1), 'A: 1', IF ((Bound_Lawyer_Count__c >= 2 && Bound_Lawyer_Count__c <= 5), 'B: 2 to 5', IF ((Bound_Lawyer_Count__c >= 6 && Bound_Lawyer_Count__c <= 10), 'C: 6 to 10', IF ((Bound_Lawyer_Count__c >= 11 && Bound_Lawyer_Count__c <= 25), 'D: 11 to 25', IF ((Bound_Lawyer_Count__c > 26), 'E: 26+', 'Unknown' )))))
CustomField.label: Grouping - Original Lawyers (BR)
